items.title: Quasi-projectivity of a regular two dimensional scheme over a Noetherian base

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a separated morphism of finite type whose source is regular of dimension two and whose base is a Noetherian scheme has quasi-projective source (statement lines 5049-5054). The proof (proof lines 5055-5080) applies Chow's lemma, extends the resulting rational map along a sequence of blowups in closed points, transfers quasi-projectivity to the last blowup through permanence of projective morphisms, and descends it along the chain using the contraction lemma and uniqueness of contractions. H3: a multi-step reduction, written out in full.
